name: GroupSexWithPlayer
description: Starts a sex scene of the player with two to four NPCs here, after the player confirms.
note: Replaces the Mantella Community Resources - ostim action of the same name. Offered as the Hub decides (Intimacy: NPC decides or Lovers only); the NPC accepts or declines, and a decline is shown and remembered. Handled by this module, which asks the player first; the file name stays so the Community Resources action is replaced.

decision.description: The NPCs' own choice as who they are: accept if they all want it now, else decline (nothing starts; it is remembered).

reason.description: A few words, in the NPC's own words.

prompt:
ANIMATION TRIGGER: starts a group sex scene with the player and two or more NPCs. Use it when the player clearly asks for group sex now or clearly agrees to it, with decision accept if the named NPCs want it or decline if not (they decide as the people they are and may refuse), and a short reason. Only the player's own clear yes in this conversation counts; an NPC's wish or an event line is not enough. Never name a child. Do not use it for flirting, for talk about sex some other time, or while a scene is already running.

If it applies, begin your response with '{key}:'.
